subject: general
question: The famous Nelapattu Bird Sanctuary is located in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Andhra Pradesh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Nelapattu Bird Sanctuary** is located in the** Nellore district of Andhra Pradesh.**
 
• It was established in** 1976** and covers an **area of 458 hectares.**
 
• The sanctuary is home to over **200 species of birds, **including **pelicans, painted storks, spoonbills, and ibises.**
 
• Besides birdwatching, visitors can enjoy boating, nature walks, and photography at the sanctuary.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tamil Nadu - **Tamil Nadu has several bird sanctuaries, including the Vedanthangal Bird Sanctuary and Point Calimere Wildlife and Bird Sanctuary. - However, Nelapattu Bird Sanctuary is not located in Tamil Nadu.
 
• **Karnataka -** Karnataka is home to several bird sanctuaries, including Ranganathittu Bird Sanctuary and Bhadra Wildlife Sanctuary. - However, Nelapattu Bird Sanctuary is not located in Karnataka.
 
• **Madhya Pradesh** - Madhya Pradesh is known for its national parks and wildlife sanctuaries, including Bandhavgarh National Park and Kanha National Park. - However, Nelapattu Bird Sanctuary is not located in Madhya Pradesh.
